name: Panera Classic Grilled Cheese on Classic White Sourdough
whyItWorks: Melted American cheese grilled on sliced white sourdough bread. Provides comforting warmth and easy calories during recovery when greasy meats and veggies must be avoided.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order: 'Classic Grilled Cheese on Country Rustic Sourdough.' Pair with a cup of Homestyle Chicken Noodle Soup.
